audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart claimed Shen wins rows 2,3,6,7 and Skill on 1,4,5. The mirror audit (illaoi__shen) flipped all seven rows to Illaoi in both layers, and the packet chart also reads Illaoi for rows 2-6.
audit.why: Directions must not contradict; mirror-fix.js would overwrite this anyway.
audit.corrected: All seven rows set to Illaoi in full (phases[N].side) and content (win[N]) as one atomic paired group. diff raised to HARD, diffRating 7/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes and phase text treated Iceborn Gauntlet and 2+ items as the point Shen takes the lane back.
audit.why: Illaoi still owns the ground inside an established tentacle field at two items; Shen's real spike is Stand United's map value, not the 1v1.
audit.corrected: spikes[3], whys[6], phases[5].why and phases[6].why rewritten: tank stats survive the burst, the 1v1 is still hers, the edge is R elsewhere. Test of Spirit's 16s rank-1 cooldown added as the fight trigger.

audit.whatIsWrong: Leap of Faith's untargetable window was never mentioned, dontsFull[1].d and dosFull[2].d carried filler text unrelated to their titles, and Illaoi was referred to as 'his'.
audit.why: Dumping Shadow Dash and autos into Leap of Faith wastes the whole commit; the E tether echoing damage is the actual reason not to be pulled near a vessel.
audit.corrected: whys[4] states Leap of Faith (120s rank 1) goes untargetable mid-cast; dontsFull[1].d states the spirit echoes damage and must be broken; dosFull[2].d ties Spirit's Refuge to her leap; tradeGood names Test of Spirit instead of 'his answer'.

audit.why: Anti-heal is already core in breakdown.late and report[8]; Prophet of an Elder God heals off every tentacle hit on a champion, so Grievous Wounds timing is already stated.

edits.before: E-taunt her off her field — W-block, roam with R. Shen wins the Test of Spirit cooldown windows.
edits.after: Shadow Dash her off her tentacles — W-block, roam with R. She wins the 1v1; your R wins the map.

edits.before: Pull the blade through Illaoi, E-taunt when his answer is down, and weave the empowered autos — then shove and watch the map.
edits.after: Pull the blade through Illaoi, E-taunt when Test of Spirit is down, and weave the empowered autos — then shove and watch the map.

edits.before: W spirit zone blanks his auto window. Only take the trade when Illaoi's Test of Spirit is down.
edits.after: Test of Spirit unlocks at 2 and she wants it instantly — trade only in the 16s after she misses it.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Test of Spirit's cooldown.
edits.after: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — fight only when Test of Spirit is down (16s rank 1), clear of tentacles.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Illaoi carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Her field still wins the ground at two items — your edge is Stand United, so pressure the side and R the fight she cannot reach.

edits.before: Illaoi wastes Test of Spirit — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Drop it as she leaps in — blocked autos while her Q slam is on cooldown.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Her spirit echoes damage and tentacles slam it — break tether fast.

edits.before: Stand United comes online and immediately reframes the matchup — concede this lane entirely if needed and convert your global R into bot or mid advantages she can never match.
edits.after: Leap of Faith (120s at rank 1) goes untargetable mid-cast, so never dump a commit into it — Stand United is your real six: concede the lane and cash the global instead.

edits.before: At 2+ items your tank build absorbs the tentacle burst and your E-taunt pattern outpaces her immobility; play split-pressure and R into teamfights — she cannot follow and cannot match your map presence.
edits.after: At 2+ items your tank build absorbs tentacle burst, but she still owns the ground inside her field; take the 1v1 only clear of tentacles and spend Stand United where she cannot follow.

edits.before: At 2+ items the lane evens back out — her tentacle density can no longer burst you through your full tank build and your global R plus split-pressure outpaces her immobility.
edits.after: At 2+ items she still wins the direct 1v1 inside her tentacles, but your tank stats survive it — take the trade only after Shadow Dash drags her clear, and cash R elsewhere.
